title: Act: Validate frame counts and animation frames in assetSchema
description: Add dimension and animation index checks to the spritesheet superRefine.

steps.action: After the existing frames/dimensions checks, add: when both asset.frames and asset.dimensions are defined, if frames.frameWidth*frames.frameCount > dimensions.width add an issue at path ['frames','frameCount'] message 'frameCount exceeds sheet width'; if frames.frameHeight > dimensions.height add an issue at ['frames','frameHeight'] message 'frameHeight exceeds sheet height'; then for each [name, anim] of Object.entries(asset.animations ?? {}) if any frame >= frames.frameCount add an issue at ['animations', name, 'frames'] message 'animation frame out of range'. Also apply the animation check when type is not spritesheet is unnecessary; keep it spritesheet-only.
steps.code: if (asset.frames && asset.dimensions && asset.frames.frameWidth * asset.frames.frameCount > asset.dimensions.width) { ctx.addIssue({ code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom, path: ['frames','frameCount'], message: 'frameCount exceeds sheet width' }); }
steps.expected: Invalid sheets produce path-named issues; valid ones unchanged
